title: iksir.json
description: Al-Kimyawi's configuration, at $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/iksir/iksir.json. Secrets never live here; they ride .env.

wasfat.description: Sijill al-Wasfat, iksir's own register of formulae.

sabiqa.description: The mark minted wasfa names carry: W gives W-1, W-2, … Default W.

namatWasfa.description: A regex that recognises a wasfa name in al-Kimyawi's words, when the default (PREFIX-123) does not fit.

khabath.description: The outer tracker al-Kimyawi's tickets live in, as a host CLI or web2 names it: github, linear, … The khuddam fetch from it and inscribe into the Sijill; iksir itself never speaks to it.

hum.description: The nest iksir nestles at. The socket is discovered; only the model is named here.

namudhaj.description: Model id named on every prompt; humd routes to a nurse advertising it. IKSIR_HUM_MODEL in .env overrides. Omit to let the nest decide.

isharat.description: Signals beyond Telegram. Telegram itself is configured by TELEGRAM_* in .env.
